an5.191:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave porāṇā brāhmaṇadhammā etarahi sunakhesu sandissanti no brāhmaṇesu.
an5.191:1.3: Pubbe sudaṃ bhikkhave brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ yeva gacchanti no abrāhmaṇiṃ.
an5.191:1.4: Etarahi bhikkhave brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇim pi gacchanti abrāhmaṇim pi gacchanti.
an5.191:1.5: Etarahi bhikkhave sunakhā sunakhiṃ yeva gacchanti no asunakhiṃ.
an5.191:1.6: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati no brāhmaṇesu. 3.
an5.191:2.1: Pubbe sudaṃ bhikkhave brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ utuniṃ yeva gacchanti no anutuniṃ.
an5.191:2.2: Etarahi bhikkhave brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ utunim pi gacchanti anutunim pi gacchanti.
an5.191:2.3: Etarahi bhikkhave sunakhā sunakhiṃ utuniṃ yeva gacchanti no anutuniṃ.
an5.191:2.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati no brāhmaṇesu. 4.
an5.191:3.1: Pubbe sudaṃ bhikkhave brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ neva kiṇanti no vikkiṇanti sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ saṃsaggatthāya sampavattenti.
an5.191:3.2: Etarahi bhikkhave brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ kiṇanti pi vikkiṇanti pi sampiyena pi saṃvāsaṃ saṃsaggatthāya sampavattenti.
an5.191:3.3: Etarahi bhikkhave sunakhā sunakhiṃ neva kiṇanti no vikkiṇanti sampiyen' eva saṃvāsaṃ saṃsaggatthāya sampavattenti.
an5.191:3.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati no brāhmaṇesu. 5.
an5.191:4.1: Pubbe sudaṃ bhikkhave brāhmaṇā na sannidhiṃ karonti dhanassa pi dhaññassa pi rajatassa pi jātarūpassa pi.
an5.191:4.2: Etarahi bhikkhave brāhmaṇā sannidhiṃ karonti dhanassa pi dhaññassa pi rajatassa pi jātarūpassa pi.
an5.191:4.3: Etarahi bhikkhave sunakhā na sannidhiṃ karonti dhanassa pi dhaññassa pi rajatassa pi jātarūpassa pi.
an5.191:4.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati no brāhmaṇesu. 6.
an5.191:5.1: Pubbe sudaṃ bhikkhave brāhmaṇā sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya bhikkhaṃ pariyesanti.
an5.191:5.2: Etarahi bhikkhave brāhmaṇā yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā avasesaṃ ādāya pakkamanti.
an5.191:5.3: Etarahi bhikkhave sunakhā sāyaṃ sāyamāsāya pāto pātarāsāya bhikkhaṃ pariyesanti.
an5.191:5.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo etarahi sunakhesu sandissati no brāhmaṇesu.
an5.191:5.5: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca porāṇā brāhmaṇadhammā etarahi sunakhesu sandissanti no brāhmaṇesū
